changelog: Load on/off, manual mode and restore now wait out the gap between controller frames instead of sending into it
A command no longer collides with the gateway's own two-minute parameter refresh, and a late reply can no longer advance a step it never answered
A controller or BMS that answers in an unreadable dialect now says so, with the values, instead of looking exactly like silence
A failed device selection gives the previous controller its learned Modbus address back; dropped Bluetooth frames are counted
